notes: Wireshark will flag the duplicate frames as retransmissions; Packet Doctor should recognise them as the same frame (same IP ID) and exclude them.
description: Upload captured on the sending host with TSO (segments of 14,600 bytes and IPv4 length 0), a download with packets missing from the capture but ACKed by the receiver, and duplicated frames from a mirror port. Expected: three capture-artefact findings and NO packet-loss finding.
